# Project Phoenix v47.0 — Alt-History Situation 1: Mamluk Suez Canal & Red Sea Spice Hegemony (1485-1585).
# Native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live 0..100 meters `oe_v47_suez_canal_progress` & `oe_v47_spice_dominion`).
# Human-friendly & AI-restrained (`is_ai = no` or `has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed`).
# Generated by gen_v470_alt_mamluk_timurid.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v47_mamluk_suez = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v47_mamluk_suez

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1485
		current_year <= 1585
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_suez_ended }
		country_exists = c:MAM
		c:MAM = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
			owns = location:cairo
			owns = location:suez
		}
		OR = {
			has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = MAM
					tag = VEN
					tag = POR
					tag = GUJ
					tag = ZMR
					tag = TUR
					tag = YEM
					tag = ORM
					tag = OMA
					tag = VIJ
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							region = region:egypt_region
							region = region:arabia_region
							region = region:western_india_region
							area = area:veneto_area
							area = area:malabar_area
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			tag = MAM
			tag = VEN
			tag = POR
			tag = GUJ
			tag = ZMR
			tag = TUR
			tag = YEM
			tag = ORM
			tag = OMA
			tag = VIJ
			tag = ETH
			tag = GEN
			tag = CAS
			tag = SPA
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:egypt_region
					region = region:arabia_region
					region = region:western_india_region
					region = region:deccan_region
					area = area:veneto_area
					area = area:malabar_area
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Canal of Two Seas & Red Sea Thalassocracy (canal >= 85 & spice >= 75)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_suez_out_thalassocracy"
		desc = "oe_v47_suez_out_thalassocracy_desc"
		trigger = {
			country_exists = c:MAM
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_suez_canal_progress }
				var:oe_v47_suez_canal_progress >= 85
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_spice_dominion }
				var:oe_v47_spice_dominion >= 75
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_ended value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_canal_completed value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = MAM
						tag = VEN
						tag = GUJ
						tag = ZMR
						has_variable = oe_v47_suez_coalition_member
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 20
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_mod_suez_thalassocracy years = 35 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Cape of Good Hope Monopoly (spice <= 20 after 1525 with Portugal active)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_suez_out_cape_triumph"
		desc = "oe_v47_suez_out_cape_triumph_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1525
			country_exists = c:POR
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_spice_dominion }
				var:oe_v47_spice_dominion <= 20
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_ended value = 2 }
			c:POR = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					}
					add_prestige = 20
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_mod_cape_spice_monopoly years = 30 mode = replace }
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = MAM
						tag = VEN
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_mod_levant_trade_recalibration years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Dual-Route Spice Equilibrium (1585 era close)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_suez_out_dual_route"
		desc = "oe_v47_suez_out_dual_route_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1585
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = MAM
						tag = VEN
						tag = POR
						tag = GUJ
						tag = ZMR
						has_variable = oe_v47_suez_coalition_member
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_mod_dual_spice_equilibrium years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_canal_progress value = 15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v47_spice_dominion value = 45 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu2_1_seen }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						is_ai = no
						OR = {
							tag = MAM
							tag = VEN
							tag = POR
							tag = GUJ
							tag = ZMR
							tag = TUR
							tag = YEM
							tag = ORM
							capital ?= {
								OR = {
									region = region:egypt_region
									region = region:arabia_region
									region = region:western_india_region
									area = area:veneto_area
									area = area:malabar_area
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						tag = MAM
						has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu2_1_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_coalition_member value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu2_ev_cd value = 1 days = 360 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu2.1
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_suez_canal_progress } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_canal_progress value = 15 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_spice_dominion } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_spice_dominion value = 45 } }

		# Live excavation progress from Suez & Nile engineering
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:MAM
				c:MAM = {
					owns = location:cairo
					owns = location:suez
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_mod_pharaonic_canal_works
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_mod_bitter_lakes_hydraulics
						has_reform = government_reform:oe_v47_ref_mamluk_red_sea_admiralty
					}
				}
				var:oe_v47_suez_canal_progress < 88
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_canal_progress add = 0.45 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:VEN
				c:VEN = { has_country_modifier = oe_v47_mod_venetian_timber_convoy }
				var:oe_v47_suez_canal_progress < 85
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_canal_progress add = 0.25 }
		}

		# Live Red Sea vs Cape Spice Dominion tug-of-war
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:MAM
				c:MAM = {
					owns = location:alexandria
					owns = location:suez
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_mod_red_sea_armada
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_mod_cairo_spice_bourse
					}
				}
				var:oe_v47_spice_dominion < 88
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_spice_dominion add = 0.40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:POR
				c:POR = {
					OR = {
						owns = location:goa
						owns = location:diu
						owns = location:hormuz
					}
				}
				var:oe_v47_spice_dominion > 14
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_spice_dominion add = -0.35 }
		}

		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_suez_canal_progress > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_canal_progress value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_suez_canal_progress < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_canal_progress value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_spice_dominion > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_spice_dominion value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_spice_dominion < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_spice_dominion value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_suez_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_suez_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = MAM tag = YEM tag = ORM tag = OMA } }
					region = region:egypt_region
					area = area:red_sea_area
					area = area:sinai_area
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_suez_map_mamluk_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { tag = VEN }
					area = area:veneto_area
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_suez_map_venice_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = GUJ tag = ZMR tag = VIJ } }
					area = area:gujarat_area
					area = area:malabar_area
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_suez_map_india_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { tag = POR }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_suez_map_portugal_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = MAM tag = YEM tag = ORM tag = OMA } }
					region = region:egypt_region
					area = area:sinai_area
				}
			}
			value = yellow_dark
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { tag = VEN }
					area = area:veneto_area
				}
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = GUJ tag = ZMR tag = VIJ } }
					area = area:gujarat_area
					area = area:malabar_area
				}
			}
			value = green
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { tag = POR }
			}
			value = red_mid
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

		desc = "oe_v47_suez_legend_mamluk"
